# Resources: Websites

Galleries and pattern collections for marketing sites, landing pages, portfolios, stores and their sections. Galleries show what designers admire, not what converts or what users can use: pair one gallery with a real-product or evidence source.

Access reads `cost · agent access · licence`. Agent access: `static` = a plain web fetch can read it; `js` = needs a real browser; `blocked` = bot protection or a login wall, send the user the link instead; `unknown` = could not be reached from the maintainer's network when last checked (not proof that it is down). `login` = content is gated. Tier: `S` first place to look, `A` strong, `B` niche or with a clear weakness.

## Curated site galleries

For overall art direction. Open the live site - thumbnails hide type rendering, motion and responsiveness.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Siteinspire](https://www.siteinspire.com) | Long-running, restrained curation; best for typographic, editorial and studio sites with staying power | Browse /websites and combine Styles, Types and Subjects filters | free · blocked | S |
| [Recent Design](https://recent.design) | Daily human-curated design inspiration and the successor of Godly (godly.website now redirects here): websites by category, plus OG images, App Store screenshots and app icons | /websites with category filters (AI, SaaS, Portfolio, Ecommerce, Agency...), /og-images, /app-store-screenshots, /app-icons, /tools, /skills | free · static | S |
| [Minimal Gallery](https://minimal.gallery) | Minimal websites: whitespace, type-led layouts, quiet palettes | Category filters in the header (portfolio, agency, e-commerce, etc.) | free · unknown | A |
| [A1 Gallery](https://a1.gallery) | Broad, well-tagged curation of current sites with many categories (Landing, Portfolio, AI, SaaS) | Pick a category first; good for seeing what is current in one vertical | free · static | A |
| [Httpster](https://httpster.net) | Eclectic, personality-rich sites; a counterweight to SaaS sameness | Browse by type and style | free · static | A |
| [Hover States](https://www.hoverstat.es) | Alternative and experimental web design where interaction is the idea | Watch the capture videos; open the site for the real behaviour | free · static | A |
| [Klikkentheke](https://klikkentheke.com) | Websites by and for graphic designers: type-driven, cultural, anti-template | Use when a brief asks for editorial or art-school energy | free · js | A |
| [Curated Design](https://www.curated.design) | Clean multi-category gallery with consistent full-page captures | Filter by category; good for quick side-by-side scanning | free · static | A |
| [Seesaw](https://www.seesaw.website) | Fast-moving curation of new sites, tagged by type, style and even typeface | Filter by tag including fonts and frameworks | free · static | A |
| [Best Website Gallery](https://bestwebsite.gallery) | One curator's long-running pick of quality sites with colour and tag filters | Filter by colour or tag | free · static | B |
| [Maxibestof](https://maxibestof.one) | Small, opinionated selection of studio and portfolio sites | Skim chronologically | free · blocked | B |
| [Siiimple](https://siiimple.com) | Minimalist sites archive; useful second source after Minimal Gallery | Browse categories | free · static · slow | B |
| [Web Design Museum](https://www.webdesignmuseum.org) | History of web design 1991-2006; reference for retro, Y2K and early-web aesthetics | Browse by year or by site timeline | free · blocked | B |

## Landing pages and SaaS marketing

For page narrative and section order. Full-page captures show how the argument is sequenced.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Land-book](https://land-book.com) | Largest well-filtered landing-page gallery; the default start for any marketing page | Filter by category, style and colour; search by keyword (pricing, waitlist, fintech) | freemium · blocked | S |
| [Lapa Ninja](https://www.lapa.ninja) | Landing pages with full-page screenshots, grouped by industry and by colour | Use /category/<industry>/ pages; full-length captures show section order | free · blocked | S |
| [One Page Love](https://onepagelove.com) | One-page sites and landing pages, tagged by purpose and by section type | Use /inspiration/<category> and the section tags to see how one-pagers are sequenced | free · static | A |
| [SaaS Landing Page](https://saaslandingpage.com) | SaaS-only landing pages, also sliced by page type (pricing, features, about) | Filter by page type to compare one kind of page across products | free · js | A |
| [Saaspo](https://saaspo.com) | SaaS sites indexed by page type, section type, style and stack | Go straight to a section type (hero, pricing, testimonials, footer) | free · blocked | A |
| [Landingfolio](https://www.landingfolio.com) | Landing pages plus a component-level view (hero, pricing, FAQ, CTA); templates are paid | Use the Inspiration tab by component | freemium · static | A |
| [Landing Love](https://www.landing.love) | Landing pages chosen for their motion, shown as video captures | Use when scroll and load choreography matters | free · static | B |

## Section and element galleries

When the question is one section (hero, nav, pricing, footer, CTA, email). Compare ten solutions to the same problem.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Really Good Emails](https://reallygoodemails.com) | The reference for email design, with code view per email | Browse by category (onboarding, receipt, newsletter); inspect the HTML | free · static | S |
| [Navbar Gallery](https://navbar.gallery) | Navigation only: navbars, mega menus, dropdowns, sidebars, mobile menus | Filter by navigation type; compare how sites handle many links and the CTA | free · static | A |
| [Supahero](https://supahero.io) | Hero sections only, a focused library of above-the-fold compositions | Scan for hero strategy (product shot, typographic, video, interactive) before choosing one | free · static | A |
| [Email Love](https://emaillove.com) | Curated email designs and components, tagged by type and brand | Second source after Really Good Emails | free · blocked | A |
| [Bento Grids](https://bentogrids.com) | Bento-grid layouts collected from real sites; a dated trend, use knowingly | Reference for module sizing and rhythm when a bento section is justified | free · js | B |
| [Footer](https://www.footer.design) | Footers only: sitemap structure, legal, newsletter, big-type sign-offs | Skim for information architecture of the footer | free · static | B |
| [CTA Gallery](https://www.cta.gallery) | Call-to-action sections and buttons from real sites | Compare closing-CTA compositions and copy | free · static | B |
| [Pricing Pages](https://pricingpages.design) | Pricing pages and plan tables | Compare plan count, the recommended-plan emphasis and toggle patterns | free · static | B |
| [404s](https://www.404s.design) | 404 pages: a good source for brand voice in error and empty states | Skim for tone and illustration approach | free · static | B |

## Niche and regional galleries

Dark mode, brutalist, e-commerce, portfolios, and Japanese galleries - the best public references for CJK typographic layout.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| [Commerce Cream](https://commercecream.com) | Best-looking e-commerce storefronts, mostly Shopify | Study product page and cart patterns with real constraints | free · unknown | A |
| [Ecomm.design](https://ecomm.design) | E-commerce sites filterable by platform, category and tech stack | Filter by vertical (fashion, food, beauty) | free · static | A |
| [Bestfolios](https://www.bestfolios.com) | Designer portfolios, case studies and resumes | Use for portfolio structure and case-study storytelling | free · js | A |
| [SANKOU! (ja)](https://sankoudesign.com) | Japanese web gallery with fine-grained filters; the closest high-quality reference for CJK typographic layout | Filter by industry, page type, colour and layout; transferable to Chinese typesetting | free · static | A |
| [MUUUUU.ORG (ja)](https://muuuuu.org) | Japanese long-scroll sites curated for craft | Study vertical rhythm and mixed-script typography | free · static | A |
| [81-web.com (ja)](https://81-web.com) | Japanese web design gallery with category and colour filters | Second source for CJK layout references | free · js | A |

## Award sites

Ambition, motion and WebGL. Juries reward spectacle; usability and conversion are not judged.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com) | Jury-scored showcase of ambitious web work; strongest for motion, WebGL and art direction, weakest for usability | Use /websites/<category>/ and the Collections (transitions, scrolling, microinteractions); read the scores critically | freemium · static | S |
| [The FWA](https://thefwa.com) | Long-running award for cutting-edge digital experiences | Use for immersive and campaign-style references | free · js | A |
| [CSS Design Awards](https://www.cssdesignawards.com) | Award gallery scored on UI, UX and innovation | Second opinion after Awwwards | free · unknown | A |

## Conversion and copy

Structure and messaging evidence for pages that must persuade.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Marketing Examples](https://marketingexamples.com) | Short, concrete teardowns of copy, landing pages and conversion tactics | Read the copywriting and landing-page sections before writing a hero | free · static | S |
| [Julian Shapiro: Landing Pages](https://www.julian.com/guide/startup/landing-pages) | The clearest handbook on landing-page structure: hero, social proof, features, objections, CTA | Read once; use as the checklist for page narrative | free · static · slow | S |
| [Demand Curve playbooks](https://www.demandcurve.com/playbooks) | Growth playbooks including above-the-fold and landing-page teardowns | Use the above-the-fold playbook when drafting a hero | free · static | A |
| [GoodUI](https://goodui.org) | UI patterns backed by A/B test results, including ones that lost | Check a pattern's evidence before arguing for it | freemium · static | A |
| [Swipe File](https://swipefile.com) | Large swipe file of ads, landing pages and copy with commentary | Search by format when stuck on messaging | free · static | B |
